answer: Votes in the shared meadow gain weight only with time: each ballot starts at 1 and doubles every 7 days, capped at 8x. A farm spinning up 100 fresh identities gets 100 weak votes; matching one veteran takes 21 days per fake. Every ballot docks in the harbor tally with a pigment tag from its work history; copied ballots cluster and trigger a review that resets linked identities to 1x and burns 25% of their escrow.
